lessons.observation: A feature can be optional and still violate launch architecture when it carries alternate vendors, broad case serialization and no registered-tool boundary.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Rules fallback worked; direct multi-vendor transport and broad input failed the successor overlay.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: Provider helper predated the OpenAI-only central-gateway owner decision.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: Source audit of lib/aiProviders.js, .env.example and render.yaml.
lessons.product_change_made: Replaced active transport with the OpenAI-only central registered-tool gateway and minimal input projection.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added alternate-vendor, arbitrary-prompt, injection, schema, log-minimization and dark-state release checks.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prioritize shared high-leverage safety architecture before portal-specific AI surface expansion.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Every provider/model/prompt/schema/source change must rerun affected registered-tool evaluations and preserve deterministic fallback.

lessons.observation: Code readiness, key presence, deployment, live smoke, portal compatibility and stabilization are distinct maturity states.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Existing NO_GO discipline worked; no unified five-product AI truth record existed.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: AI state was represented only indirectly by environment variables and an optional provider status.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: Overlay sections 19, 24A and 24H plus control-center source audit.
lessons.product_change_made: Added five-product capability matrix and protected AI Operations owner view.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added exact maturity and live-smoke boundaries to the OpenAI launch validator and release records.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Do not select broader AI use until central dark deployment and one portal canary are evidence-ready.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Recovery must restore exact contract, registry, matrix and kill-switch defaults before any live activation.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact OpenAI model snapshot is available and approved in the production project at live-smoke time?
Which exact Render service and GitHub repository identities will own the central gateway deployment?
next_version_learning_priorities: Controlled live smoke evidence without user data
Non-AI launch readiness progress in parallel
